claudemm.notes: ClaudeMMConsole: the mind map in a terminal (ClaudeMMConsole.exe, installed next to the app; the installer can add the folder to PATH): the same tree, tags, notes, renames, cut/paste, new nodes, continue a chat, new project, web servers, with keyboard search. A disk explorer in the window and the console: all folders, or only the ones that lead to chats. The mind map's tree moved into MapTree.hpp, shared by the window and the console. ClaudeMM also builds and runs on Linux (SDL2 / Cairo / Pango through ChronoUI's Linux port): scanner, list, map, inspector and web servers; data under ~/.config/ChronoUI.
